lines.text: &fLetters from the server staff: news, apologies, gifts. Some are sent to everyone, some only to you.
&7Pick a letter in the list to open it. Opening the tab lands on your newest unread letter. A long title scrolls when you hover its row.
&7An unread letter has a &6marked&7 icon, and the Letters tab and the hub button in your inventory show a mark while any are waiting.
&7Under the title you see who wrote it, when, and how long until it &cexpires&7. The whole letter is always shown, including what is attached &8- hover an attachment for details.
&7Press &aAccept&7 to take what is attached: money goes to your balance, items to your inventory (dropped at your feet if it is full), and a command attachment runs for you.
&7A letter with nothing attached has &fMark as read&7 instead.
&7Each letter can be accepted once. It stays in your list afterwards, and letters disappear when they expire &8- so accept gifts in time.
